verdict.rationale: Raygun documents native repo integrations (GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab) and source map decoding for stack traces, plus deployment tracking to correlate errors with releases, but there is no evidence of suspect-commit identification, code owner attribution, or direct jump-to-line-on-default-branch navigation from a stack frame. missing for 10: evidence of blame/suspect-commit detection, code owner mapping, and click-through-to-exact-source-line functionality.
